scheme_name: CGTMSE (Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises)
target_segment: MSEs (Micro and Small Enterprises) without collateral
one_line_eligibility: Both existing and new MSEs are eligible; requires formal business registration (Udyam).

scheme_name: MUDRA (Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd.) - Shishu
one_line_eligibility: Any individual, including women, proprietary concern, partnership firm, private limited company or any other entity are eligible.

target_segment: Entrepreneurs who have started a business and want to expand
one_line_eligibility: Suitable for existing micro units seeking expansion funding.

target_segment: New micro enterprises in non-farm sector (manufacturing/services)
collateral_requirement: None for loans up to ₹10 lakh (under CGTMSE)
one_line_eligibility: Any individual above 18 years of age setting up a new project/micro enterprise; at least VIII standard pass for projects above ₹10 lakh (Mfg) / ₹5 lakh (Service).

nodal_agency: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & SIDBI
one_line_eligibility: Street vendors vending in urban areas, formal registration (Udyam) not strictly required but ULB certificate needed.
